comment: steal.c somegold() caps the purse at global.h LARGEST_INT (32767) before choosing how much a leprechaun takes, so an 80000-piece purse draws rn1(27768, 5000). A human Samurai in debug mode wishes for a tin whistle and 80000 gold pieces, creates a hostile leprechaun (generated asleep), wakes it with the whistle, and lets it hit. The seed is the first of 7340001-7340030 whose leprechaun hits on its first move (port scan; 19 of 30 did).
